text_block_list.text:
I was on my way home from an outing with 
Sakura Bakushin O――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Are you aware, Trainer? Did you know that 
my rival is coming here, right now?

When I was told that, I thought of the Uma 
Musume of her generation…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You already know, don't you? Indeed, my 
rival is――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The fastest king of the sea! The 
"Sailfish"!!
choice_data_list: I didn't think it was a fish!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The one who commands the land, is me. The 
one who commands the seas is… that fish, 
for now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: However! One day, I will take that name and call myself the fastest on land and sea!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To master speed is a prerequisite for the 
strongest Uma Musume and the strongest 
honor-roll student!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, let's G.O. to the 
aquarium, which is open to the public for 
a limited time!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Excuse meeee―!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oops, pardon me! The class president was 
getting excited just now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now, without further ado, let's find the 
enemy! Where on earth could he～…Ah.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's a school of sardines! Eating 
sardines makes you smarter!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I heard that, I've been eating 
them from head to tail!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to this, I am very intelligent. The 
sailfish must be terrified.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And, ohh! Look at that! Swimming over 
there, that's…!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's a "yellowtail", the fish they call 
the fish of success! Before they grow up, 
they're called things like "Mejiro" and 
"Warasa"――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oya? So the McQueens will eventually 
become "yellowtail" McQueens?
choice_data_list:
More than that, we're looking for a 
sailfish!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! It was an elite fish 
that I couldn't pass up, but nevertheless, 
how careless of me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My hunch is that they should be around 
here somewhere! Let's seeee… the fish in 
the tank next to――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Sailfish"…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Haa… haah… that's, a sailfish. Somehow, it 
looks a bit like me, doesn't it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This… sharp, fast-looking expression… like 
that……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Sure enough, I still want to compete with 
you! But, this is a museum, and we can't 
break the rules…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Kuuuuuu～～! What am I supposed to 
dooo～～!
choice_data_list:
Maybe try something like racing in your 
brain.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see… So, you think we should know our 
rivals and make preparations for a future 
time?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I'll use my sardine-trained 
brain to uncover the secret to the 
sailfish's speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hoho… Hoouuuh! Did you see that!? The dorsal fin went swoosh!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see, I seeeeee! Now I know the 
whole secret to speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: To sum it up, the trick is to… swoosh the dorsal fin with all your might!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fu-fu-fuu～! This is the result of eating 
sardines!

I don't know how that would help her 
without a dorsal fin, but… she seemed 
satisfied, so it was fine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Racing, in my brain!? My honors student 
heart was just completely shocked!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
…My brain… in my brain, with the sailfish… 
a race……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for you… sailfish!

text_block_list.name: Sailfish
text_block_list.text: Oh… You're the fastest Uma Musume on the track, aren't ya? I'm fast and my stamina is craaaazy. You sure you can beat me?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's my line! Watch your back… No, watch 
your dorsal fin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushinbakushiiii―n!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It was an excellent battle of speed and 
stamina! I may even want to go as far as 
to rename myself Mejiro Bakushin O.

I don't know what's going on in her brain, 
but she seems to have gotten a handle on 
it…!
